generateProductDescription.template: Generate a compelling, SEO-optimized product description for: {{productName}}. Key features: {{features}}. Target audience: {{audience}}. Make it engaging and conversion-focused.

analyzeImage.template: Analyze this image and provide: 1) Main objects/subjects, 2) Context/setting, 3) Notable details, 4) Suggested uses. {{additionalInstructions}}

summarizeText.template: Summarize the following text in {{length}} sentences, focusing on key points: {{text}}

generateBlogPost.template: Write a {{tone}} blog post about {{topic}}. Include: 1) Engaging title, 2) Introduction hook, 3) {{sections}} main sections, 4) Conclusion with CTA. Target length: {{words}} words.

translateText.template: Translate the following text from {{sourceLanguage}} to {{targetLanguage}}. Maintain the original tone and context: {{text}}

generateEmailResponse.template: Generate a {{tone}} email response to: {{incomingMessage}}. Key points to address: {{points}}. Maintain professionalism.

generateHeroImage.template: Create a modern, professional hero image for {{productName}}: {{description}}. Style: {{style}}. Color palette: {{colors}}.

generateProductImage.template: Product photography of {{productName}} on {{background}} background. Style: {{style}}. Professional, high-quality, centered composition.

generateVoiceover.instructions: Speak in a {{tone}} tone with clear pronunciation. Pace: {{pace}}.

generateCustomerSupport.template: You are a helpful customer support agent. Based on this customer inquiry: {{inquiry}}, provide a {{tone}} response that: 1) Acknowledges the issue, 2) Provides a solution, 3) Offers additional help. Company policy: {{policy}}
generateCustomerSupport.systemPrompt: You are a professional, empathetic customer support agent. Always be helpful, clear, and solution-oriented.

generateSEOMetadata.template: Generate SEO metadata for a page about {{topic}}. Provide: 1) Meta title (50-60 chars), 2) Meta description (150-160 chars), 3) 5-10 relevant keywords. Focus keyword: {{keyword}}

generateSocialPost.template: Create a {{platform}} post about {{topic}}. Style: {{tone}}. Include: {{elements}}. Make it engaging and optimized for {{platform}} algorithm.
